description: This file defines an HTMLSerializer class for serializing HTML trees with various configurable options, including handling of entities, tags, and whitespace. It also includes error handling and encoding support.

classes.name: HTMLSerializer
classes.description: A class for serializing HTML trees with configurable options for quoting, tags, escaping, and more.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes a string using the specified encoding and error handling.

methods.name: encodeStrict
methods.description: Encodes a string strictly with the specified encoding.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a treewalker into an HTML string, applying filters and handling different token types.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Returns the serialized HTML as a string or bytes.

methods.name: serializeError
methods.description: Records a serialization error message; raises exception if strict mode is enabled.
